findings.finding: Statement selector mistook while(condition) for a function call.
findings.resolution: Require the statement head to name a declared source function; existing Q500 refusal and usage-grade pins are tested.

findings.finding: Broad qcore_ prefix exclusion would reserve user function names implicitly.
findings.resolution: Only qcore_acquire and qcore_check keep the old route; qcore_user is exercised.

findings.finding: The initial scalar emitter wrote its own main and printed an automatic OK banner/fault message.
findings.resolution: Use c_program fragments and a single entry body; remove automatic stream output; route source print(expr) through shared std.io helper fragments. Native regression covers one main, silent success/fault, and output order.

boundaries: All definitions receive ordinary type checks; only the closed entry is executed by the reference evaluator.
Lean arithmetic and relational call semantics are models; no source/Rust extraction theorem is claimed.
Existing specialized profiles retain precedence; only the explicit std.io extension is admitted, not general resource/profile call composition.

independent_review.result: No remaining concrete correctness blocker found.
independent_review.retracted_finding: An alleged zero-argument call bypass was checked with the exact arithmetic-fault reproducer; it refuses Q020 because the callee computation selects scalar globally. No code change was justified.
